title.narrative: Promoting bioethics, frontier and digital technologies in Eastern Africa

description.narrative: Consistently with Output 7.2.SHS, and PI 7.2.SHS2 and 7.2.SHS3, this workplan will aim at: • Delivery of hybrid capacity-building workshops and mentorship programmes based on the UNESCO Core Curriculum on Bioethics, with expanded thematic focus on frontier technologies such as AI, climate ethics and ethics of neurotechnology • Implementation of a comprehensive bioethics landscape analysis across selected countries to identify institutional gaps, policy needs, and emerging ethical challenges • Development and dissemination of knowledge products, including policy briefs and special issues of the Africa Journal of Bioethics, addressing frontier and digital technologies and related ethical concerns • Strengthening collaboration with the Africa Bioethics Network to enhance regional coordination, knowledge exchange, and continental reach • Support to Member States in integrating UNESCO normative frameworks into national policies and advocacy initiatives, particularly in relation to ethical governance climate change.
